section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes instruments used with the current sample: the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), the 10-item Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS) with RCM and PEM subscales, the 36-item Experiences in Close Relationships Scale (ECRS), the 23-item Almost Perfect Scale-Revised (APS-R), the 21-item Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II), the 21-item Intuitive Eating Scale (IES), and self-reported height/weight used to compute BMI. Internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha) values are reported for each measure for the current sample, and mean BMI for the sample is reported as M = 23.1 (SD = 4.8).
